usedFor: Copper holds your people and companies, and Altoviz receives them as billing contacts when “New Person” runs “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Person” in Copper, then “Create a Contact” in Altoviz
bestTemplate.why: Invoicing needs the contact before the first bill, and a new Copper person fills it without retyping.

watchOut: “Updated Person” also reaches “Create a Contact”, so an edited person could add a duplicate contact in Altoviz.
